LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_SettingTooltip: Shows an approximate time until death. When temporary bleeding control is active, compares keeping bleeding controlled with giving no more treatment. Hover for explanations and rescue advice. Chemical dependency appears only from chemical coma onward. Calculated only while this pawn's Health tab is open. Disabling restores the vanilla countdown.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_NoPrediction: No death predicted in the next 24 hours
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_OtherRisks: Other hazards or random complications may cause earlier death.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CEStabilization: CE stabilization is temporary; bleeding may return. Fully tend the wounds.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CurrentConditions: Assumes current conditions continue and no new treatment is given.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CapacityFailure: Likely cause of death: loss of {0}. Treat the underlying condition.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CurrentScenario: Bleeding stays controlled: time until death if current bandages, tourniquets and stabilization keep reducing bleeding by the same amount. Other health problems still progress; this does not assume new treatment.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_UntendedScenario: No more treatment: time until death if nobody provides further care. Temporary bleeding control weakens and wears off.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_TemporaryControl: Bleeding is reduced for now, but the wounds still need proper tending. Bleeding can return as temporary control wears off. A long estimate does not guarantee safety.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_Uncertain: The untreated bleeding baseline could not be determined. The future death estimate is uncertain.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_Scenarios: Estimated death with bleeding controlled: {0}; with no more treatment: {1}
